title: Snow Footprints
statementMd:
There is a straight snowy road, divided into $*n*$ blocks. The blocks are numbered from 1 to $*n*$ from left to right. If one moves from the $*i*$-th block to the $(*i* + 1)$-th block, he will leave a right footprint on the $*i*$-th block. Similarly, if one moves from the $*i*$-th block to the $(*i* - 1)$-th block, he will leave a left footprint on the $*i*$-th block. If there already is a footprint on the $*i*$-th block, the new footprint will cover the old one.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f41948ee78d5cb0b88a36325cd910242c3e7bcbe.png)

At the beginning, there were no footprints. Then polar bear Alice starts from the $*s*$-th block, makes a sequence of moves and ends in the $*t*$-th block. It is known that Alice never moves outside of the road.

You are given the description of Alice's footprints. Your task is to find a pair of possible values of $*s*, *t*$ by looking at the footprints.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer $*n*$ $(3 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000)$.

The second line contains the description of the road — the string that consists of $*n*$ characters. Each character will be either "`.`" (a block without footprint), or "`L`" (a block with a left footprint), "`R`" (a block with a right footprint).

It's guaranteed that the given string contains at least one character not equal to "`.`". Also, the first and the last character will always be "`.`". It's guaranteed that a solution exists.

## Output

Print two space-separated integers — the values of $*s*$ and $*t*$. If there are several possible solutions you can print any of them.

## Note

The first test sample is the one in the picture.
statementZhMd:
有一条笔直的积雪道路，被划分为 $*n*$ 个方块。这些方块从左到右编号为 1 到 $*n*$。如果从第 $*i*$ 个方块移动到第 $(*i* + 1)$ 个方块，就会在第 $*i*$ 个方块上留下一个向右的脚印。类似地，如果从第 $*i*$ 个方块移动到第 $(*i* - 1)$ 个方块，就会在第 $*i*$ 个方块上留下一个向左的脚印。如果第 $*i*$ 个方块上已经有脚印，新留下的脚印会覆盖旧脚印。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f41948ee78d5cb0b88a36325cd910242c3e7bcbe.png)

一开始道路上没有脚印。随后，北极熊 Alice 从第 $*s*$ 个方块出发，进行一系列移动，最终到达第 $*t*$ 个方块。已知 Alice 从未走出道路范围。

现在给出 Alice 留下的脚印。你的任务是根据这些脚印，找出一组可能的 $*s*$ 和 $*t*$。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(3 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000)$。

第二行包含道路的描述——一个由 $*n*$ 个字符组成的字符串。每个字符都将是“`.`”（没有脚印的方块）、“`L`”（有向左脚印的方块）或“`R`”（有向右脚印的方块）。

保证给定字符串中至少有一个字符不等于“`.`”。此外，第一个和最后一个字符始终为“`.`”。保证一定存在解。

## 输出格式

输出两个用空格分隔的整数——$*s*$ 和 $*t*$ 的值。如果有多个可能的解，输出其中任意一个即可。

## 说明

第一个样例就是图片中所示的情况。
